initial_plan.answerability: yes: the file has counts of motorist and cyclist deaths for each police-reported crash, so annual totals can be compared
initial_plan.metric: annual number of reported motorist deaths and annual number of reported cyclist deaths, each calculated by summing the corresponding killed-person column across crashes
initial_plan.population: all police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes dated 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31
initial_plan.grouping: calendar year and road-user type (motorist or cyclist)

data_check_facts_and_decisions.crash_date: No missing crash dates in the file (0); it is a DATE field, and all 13 requested years have full calendar coverage. Use all crashes dated within 2013-2025; no rows are excluded for missing dates within the requested period.
data_check_facts_and_decisions.population_size: There are 2,132,218 in-range crash rows total; yearly counts are recorded in check_1.csv (85,546 to 231,564). These counts are population context, not the denominator for the fatality-count metric.
data_check_facts_and_decisions.number_of_motorist_killed: 0 missing values among in-range crash rows; keep all in-range rows when summing.
data_check_facts_and_decisions.number_of_cyclist_killed: 0 missing values among in-range crash rows; keep all in-range rows when summing.
data_check_facts_and_decisions.year_coverage: 2013-2025 each has records from January 1 through December 31; none is partial.
data_check_facts_and_decisions.decisions: No data-driven exclusions or missing-value groups are needed. Interpret values as recorded motorist and cyclist deaths summed over police-reported crashes in each calendar year.

final_plan.answerability: yes, for the annual counts recorded in the motorist and cyclist killed-person fields of police-reported NYC crashes
final_plan.metric: annual number of recorded motorist deaths and annual number of recorded cyclist deaths, each the sum of its killed-person column across in-range crash rows
final_plan.population: all police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes with a crash_date in calendar years 2013-2025; deaths are counted by the motorist/cyclist fields, not by crash count
final_plan.grouping: calendar year and road-user type (motorist or cyclist)
final_plan.limitations: The dataset measures deaths reported on NYC motor-vehicle-crash records and only separates motorist and cyclist deaths in this comparison; it is not an exposure-adjusted risk measure or a comparison with all other road-user categories. All requested years are full, crash_date has 0 missing values in the file, and neither killed-person field has missing values among in-range rows; no in-range rows are dropped for missingness.
